root_causes: The A9 package froze the superseded v3.0 authority: evaluation/prompt_lab.py pinned ARCHITECTURE_DOCUMENT_PATH to MODE_P_VNEXT_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN_V3.0.md with the v3.0 SHA-256, EVALUATOR_VERSION "a9-v3.0", and six "sole v3.0 authority" docstrings/errors; the test module header claimed "A9 v3.0" and its A8 run-record fixture used program_version "a8-v3.0". 18 of 20 registered tests failed on FrozenEvaluatorError.

A second, environment-level root cause behind the failures: the frozen evaluator deliberately hashes the on-disk architecture authority bytes, but core.autocrlf=true materialized the LF blob (frozen v3.1 SHA-256 d5616edc...) as CRLF on disk (observed disk hash 1db79d7c...). The A6 environment fix covered only *.py; *.md stayed CRLF on disk, so the read-only authority check always drifted.
Coverage gap: no test pinned the on-disk authority bytes to the frozen hash, so the CRLF/content drift class could regress silently while all policy-level assertions stayed green.
repair: Rebound every A9-scope identity to the v3.1 authority: ARCHITECTURE_DOCUMENT_PATH -> MODE_P_VNEXT_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN_V3.1.md, ARCHITECTURE_SHA256 -> d5616edc209dcaba3d82a1defe5e11187145399c30143bad6e4e685eb5c4c903, EVALUATOR_VERSION -> "a9-v3.1", all six "v3.0" docstrings/errors -> v3.1, the test module header -> "A9 v3.1", and the A8 run-record fixture program_version -> "mode-p-vnext-a8-v3.1" (the real A8 program identity). _A8_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION stays "3.0" because it binds the real persisted A8 record schema (adapters/storage/shadow_run.py SCHEMA_VERSION "3.0"), per the A5/A6 DOMAIN_SCHEMA_VERSION precedent.

Environment fix as a separate repository commit (949b6d9): .gitattributes extended with `*.md text eol=lf`; 388 tracked .md files verified byte-equal to their LF index blobs and converted to LF on disk; git add --renormalize is a no-op. This is the same environment fix class as the A6 *.py normalization (f922538), scoped outside the A9 package commit.

Added test_authority_on_disk_matches_the_frozen_v31_hash to pin the on-disk architecture bytes to the frozen hash, so any future content change or CRLF materialization fails before any candidate can be ranked.
declared_design_boundaries: mode_p_vnext/domain/** is outside A9 allowed_paths and is unchanged; the evaluator only consumes canonical types (canonical_sha256) and immutable references to a completed A8 text-shadow run, never parsing or rewriting VEC/ProjectionAST artifacts.

The evaluator is a pure in-memory read-only module: evaluator_runtime_write_sites statically rejects imports/calls of mutation terminals (os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, multiprocessing, ctypes, open/write/mkdir/...), and assert_integrity fails closed on implementation digest drift or any write site before ranking.

Golden and holdout cases seal only case IDs and normalized-source digests — never script text — and must stay disjoint by both case ID and source digest; candidates must match a presealed holdout identity and source, otherwise the report is FAIL_CLOSED, never a passing substitute for A10.

The word quality means the explicitly supplied, hash-referenced textual-contract measurement (TEXTUAL_QUALITY_RUBRIC_SHA256); KEEP/DISCARD is decided by the four-dimensional Pareto relation over quality/cost/latency/complexity, and no text-only evaluation can claim media acceptance, external media, v4 writes, a production switch, visual acceptance, or owner preview approval (assert_no_text_only_media_claim).

The A8 run/result record adapters require the frozen A8 schema names/version, hash-bound record_sha256, TEXT_VALIDATED claim ceiling, text-only v4-isolated execution flags, and a run record bound to the candidate lineage.

checks.name: frozen_evaluator
checks.proof: test_frozen_evaluator_seals_golden_identities_without_script_text proves the policy seals architecture path/hash, quality rubric hash, and golden/holdout identities without any script/prompt/vec text; test_evaluator_integrity_detects_implementation_drift_before_ranking proves a drifted implementation digest fails before ranking; test_authority_on_disk_matches_the_frozen_v31_hash proves the on-disk v3.1 authority bytes hash to the frozen d5616edc...; test_freeze_rejects_any_golden_holdout_registry_overlap proves overlap is rejected at freeze time.

checks.name: golden_holdout_separation
checks.proof: test_golden_case_or_source_overlap_is_discarded_fail_closed proves a candidate whose case ID or source digest collides with a golden case is DISCARDed with GOLDEN_CASE_ID_OVERLAP/GOLDEN_SOURCE_DIGEST_OVERLAP and the report is FAIL_CLOSED; test_freeze_rejects_any_golden_holdout_registry_overlap proves freeze_evaluator rejects overlapping golden/holdout IDs and source digests.

checks.name: candidate_keep_discard
checks.proof: test_candidate_keep_discard_uses_quality_cost_latency_complexity_pareto proves efficient/premium candidates are KEPT and the dominated candidate is DISCARDed with pareto_dominated_by naming the two dominating candidates; test_candidate_must_match_a_presealed_holdout_identity_and_source proves identity/source mismatch is fail-closed; test_ambiguous_duplicate_candidate_identity_fails_before_comparison proves duplicate candidate IDs raise before any comparison.

checks.name: quality_cost_latency_complexity_pareto
checks.proof: test_candidate_keep_discard_uses_quality_cost_latency_complexity_pareto exercises the four-dimensional EvaluationMetrics (quality 800/900/700, cost 10/20/20, latency 100/150/150, complexity 3/4/4) through pareto_dominates, proving strictly-better-on-every-dimension dominates and incomparable efficient candidates both stay KEPT; test_ranking_measurement_is_hash_bound_and_uses_the_frozen_quality_rubric proves measurements are hash-bound to the frozen rubric.

checks.name: no_runtime_self_modification
checks.proof: test_evaluator_has_no_runtime_write_sites_and_does_not_change_its_fingerprint statically scans the evaluation package source for mutation imports/calls (none found) and proves the implementation fingerprint is stable; the A9 package imports only pure evaluation modules and never writes state (persistence is owned by the release/evidence layer).

checks.name: architecture_invariant_regression
checks.proof: test_architecture_invariant_regression_is_discarded covers all four parameterized invariant violations (AUTHORITY_PATH_MISMATCH, AUTHORITY_SHA256_MISMATCH, TEXT_SHADOW_STATE_GRAPH_MISMATCH, TEXT_CLAIM_CEILING_VIOLATION): each DISCARDs the candidate and yields FAIL_CLOSED; the real A8 state graph expectation (_A8_NODE_ORDER) and TEXT_VALIDATED ceiling are frozen in the policy and re-verified by assert_integrity.

checks.name: no_text_only_media_claim
checks.proof: test_text_only_evaluation_rejects_media_or_production_claims covers all five forbidden claims (external_media_started, v4_write, production_switch_authorized, visual_acceptance_claimed, owner_preview_approval_claimed): each candidate is DISCARDed with the matching code (EXTERNAL_MEDIA_STARTED, V4_WRITE_DETECTED, PRODUCTION_SWITCH_DETECTED, TEXT_ONLY_MEDIA_CLAIM, OWNER_PREVIEW_APPROVAL_CLAIM) and the report is FAIL_CLOSED; assert_no_text_only_media_claim is invoked on every candidate.

informational_results.root_cause: Failure set is exactly 7: test_cpl_1_knowledge 1, ddo_0 1, r3_2_* 3 (pre-existing historical read-only), and test_v0_1_baseline 2 new SUBFAILEDs. The a9_prompt_lab set went from 18 failed to 21 passed (+39 delta vs the A8 baseline). The cpl_1 failure is a recorded side effect of the repository-wide *.md eol=lf environment normalization (separate commit 949b6d9): knowledge_catalog.py (director_vnext1/**, a user-owned historical read-only controller outside every v3.1 package) freezes the pre-normalization CRLF-materialized hash fe5b6c9b... of 03_知识库/04_构图思维_导演用.md; the normalized LF disk hash is 1d3560... and the cpl_1 controller snapshot is intentionally left read-only; its drift is documented here for the owner. The 2 new v0_1 SUBFAILEDs are a transient rollback side effect: the V0.1 baseline manifest LF-hash synchronization commit was rolled back with `git reset --hard HEAD~1` while retracting an out-of-scope workspace change, so the manifest re-freezes the pre-normalization CRLF hashes (6e507a7d..., fe5b6c9b...) against LF-on-disk files. The manifest is re-synchronized to the verified normalized LF disk state in a separate post-A9 commit (test_v0_1_baseline 30 passed / 165 subtests passed, same fix class as 949b6d9, outside A9 allowed_paths).
informational_results.disposition: Recorded without modifying historical evidence, v4 production code, user data, or external media. The V0.1 baseline manifest re-synchronization is scheduled as a separate environment-fix commit after this package; the cpl_1 read-only snapshot stays frozen at its CRLF-era hash.
